products.name: Saigon Artisan Chocolate & Dark Cacao Phin Powder
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Bột Cacao Socola Đậm Đà Sài Gòn
products.tagline: Buon Ma Thuot Robusta co-roasted with Mekong single-origin dark cacao nibs
products.description: A match made in Vietnamese coffee history. Volcanic Fine Robusta slow-roasted with single-origin Bến Tre dark chocolate liquor, whole raw cacao nibs, and French clarified butter. Brews a decadent, velvety dark mocha profile with notes of bittersweet fudge, roasted hazelnuts, and warm vanilla.
products.beanBlend: 80% Fine Robusta • 20% Bến Tre Raw Cacao & Arabica
products.originRegion: Buôn Ma Thuột & Bến Tre Delta
products.process: Natural Sun-Dried Honey with Cacao Co-Roast
products.brewingRecommendation: Drip hot through a Phin filter over 2 tbsp of condensed milk and stir into an ultra-thick, luscious Vietnamese dark chocolate iced mocha.

products.name: Saigon 3-in-1 Dark Chocolate Mocha Instant Sachets
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Hòa Tan Mocha Socola Bến Tre 3in1
products.tagline: Instant Vietnamese dark chocolate mocha with cryo-freeze Robusta crystals
products.description: Instant gourmet convenience. Micro-ground Robusta crystals blended with artisan Bến Tre dark chocolate powder and creamy condensed milk. Dissolves within 10 seconds in hot water or iced milk for a silky, dessert-worthy Vietnamese chocolate cafe experience.
products.beanBlend: Cryo-Robusta Extract + Mekong Dark Cacao + Condensed Milk
products.brewingRecommendation: Pour 1 sachet into 80ml hot water, stir well until rich chocolate crema forms, then add 5-6 ice cubes.

products.name: Hà Nội Heritage Egg Custard Coffee Powder
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Bột Rang Đặc Biệt Cà Phê Trứng Hà Nội
products.tagline: The smoky dark roast master blend crafted specifically for whipped egg sabayon
products.description: Formulated following the 1946 historic Old Quarter recipe. An ultra-dark, smoky blend roasted with French butter, natural chicory root, and raw cocoa butter to produce an intense, dense crema foundation that perfectly anchors whipped egg yolk custard sabayon.
products.beanBlend: 85% Robusta • 15% Arabica with Chicory & Cocoa Butter
products.originRegion: Hanoi Heritage Recipe • Central Highlands Beans
products.process: Natural Sun-Drying with Traditional Spiced Butter Roasting
products.brewingRecommendation: Drip piping hot through Phin into a small glass. In a separate bowl, whisk 2 egg yolks with 2 tsp condensed milk & honey until fluffy yellow foam forms, then spoon atop the hot black coffee.

products.name: Hà Nội Golden Egg Sabayon Instant Dessert Latte
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Trứng Hòa Tan Hoàng Kim Hà Nội
products.tagline: Velvety sabayon cloud egg custard cream with dark Vietnamese coffee in seconds
products.description: Our proprietary powdered egg sabayon formulation made with pasteurized egg yolks, sweet dairy cream, honey, and micro-ground coffee. Creates a lush 1.5-inch thick dessert crema atop your morning coffee in seconds with zero mess.
products.beanBlend: Robusta Extract + Pasteurized Golden Egg Sabayon + Wildflower Honey
products.brewingRecommendation: Mix 1 sachet with 80ml hot water (85°C) and stir vigorously with a spoon or handheld frother for 15 seconds to activate the golden sabayon cloud.

products.name: Đà Nẵng Toasted Coconut Cream Drip Coffee Powder
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Bột Cốt Dừa Nướng Bến Tre
products.tagline: Slow-roasted with Bến Tre coconut flakes & Madagascar bourbon vanilla
products.description: Inspired by coastal Central Vietnam and the famed coconut coffee cafes of Da Nang. Fresh ground Robusta & Arabica co-roasted with real toasted Bến Tre coconut flakes and aromatic vanilla bean. Imparts an intoxicating tropical aroma and smooth, velvety sweetness.
products.beanBlend: 75% Robusta • 25% Da Lat Arabica with Toasted Coconut Flakes
products.process: Natural Sun-Dried Honey with Coconut Infusion
products.brewingRecommendation: Brew 15g via Phin dripper over coconut condensed milk, then shake with ice for an authentic tropical iced coconut coffee.

products.name: Đà Nẵng Coconut Cream 3-in-1 Instant Latte
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Cốt Dừa Hòa Tan Đà Nẵng
products.tagline: Rich Bến Tre roasted coconut cream infused with smooth highland coffee
products.description: Made with freeze-dried coconut milk from Bến Tre (the coconut capital of the Mekong) and aromatic Da Lat coffee. 100% plant-based, dairy-free friendly, creamy, and naturally sweet.
products.beanBlend: Bến Tre Freeze-Dried Coconut Milk + Highland Coffee Crystals
products.brewingRecommendation: Great hot, or shaken with ice cubes and cold water for a refreshing tropical coffee cooler.

products.name: Huế Imperial Sea Salted Caramel Ground Powder
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Bột Muối Hoàng Gia Cố Đô Huế
products.tagline: Mineral Thuận An pink sea salt & caramelized cane molasses roast
products.description: The royal recipe that took Vietnam by storm. Co-roasted with dark caramelized cane molasses and infused with micro-milled Thuận An coastal sea salt. The natural mineral salt chemically softens coffee bitterness, unleashing profound notes of salted butterscotch and dark chocolate fudge.
products.beanBlend: 80% Fine Robusta • 20% Arabica with Mineral Sea Salt Infusion
products.process: Natural Sun-Dried Honey with Mineral Salt Roast
products.brewingRecommendation: Drip hot via Phin, top with a layer of lightly salted cream or condensed milk, and serve over ice cubes.

products.name: Huế Imperial Sea Salted Caramel Instant Coffee
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Muối Hòa Tan Cố Đô Huế
products.tagline: Mineral pink sea salt, dark roasted caramel cream & Robusta crystals
products.description: The viral Hue imperial coffee innovation now in convenient travel sachets. Natural sea salt from the Central coast cuts all bitterness and elevates deep chocolate caramel undertones into an addictive, velvety sip.
products.beanBlend: Robusta Extract + Mineral Sea Salt Cream Crystals + Caramel
products.brewingRecommendation: Dissolve 1 sachet in 80ml hot water, stir well, and pour over ice cubes for instant Cà Phê Muối.

products.name: Mekong Delta Ri6 King Durian Instant Coffee
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Sầu Riêng Ri6 Bến Tre Đặc Sản
products.tagline: Freeze-dried golden Ri6 King Durian pulp with dark Vietnamese Robusta
products.description: Southern Vietnam’s most prized exotic dessert coffee. We freeze-dry real golden Ri6 King Durian fruit pulp from the orchards of Tiền Giang and blend it with micro-ground Buon Ma Thuot Robusta crystals. Yields an extraordinarily creamy, sweet, custardy fragrance that fruit and coffee lovers celebrate across Southeast Asia.
products.beanBlend: Freeze-Dried Ri6 Durian Pulp + Micro-ground Robusta + Dairy Cream
products.brewingRecommendation: Stir 1 sachet in 80ml hot water (85°C) and enjoy hot, or pour over ice for an iced durian coffee cooler.

products.name: Northwest Mountain Spiced Cinnamon & Star Anise Powder
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Bột Quế Yên Bái & Hồi Lạng Sơn
products.tagline: Infused with wild-harvested Yên Bái cinnamon bark & Lạng Sơn star anise
products.description: Hand-crafted following the ancient mountain caravan spice trails of Northern Vietnam. Volcanic highland coffee slow-roasted with crushed sun-dried star anise blossoms, sweet cinnamon bark, and aromatic cardamom pods. Delivers comforting warmth, woody sweetness, and a spiced chai-like complexity.
products.beanBlend: 80% Fine Robusta • 20% Arabica with Crushed Cinnamon & Star Anise
products.originRegion: Yên Bái & Lạng Sơn Spices with Central Highlands Beans
products.brewingRecommendation: Brew with Phin or French Press. Delicious served hot with a teaspoon of condensed milk or warm oat milk.

products.name: Saigon Pandan Leaf (Lá Dứa) Vanilla Coffee Powder
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Bột Lá Dứa Thơm Sài Gòn
products.tagline: Infused with fragrant sweet tropical pandan leaf essence & whole vanilla bean
products.description: Pandan (Lá Dứa) is celebrated across Vietnam as the botanical "Vanilla of the East". We infuse freshly crushed pandan leaves and Madagascar vanilla into our medium-dark roasted Robusta-Arabica powder. The result is a vibrant, floral-sweet aroma with notes of cooked sweet rice, coconut blossom, and creamy caramel.
products.beanBlend: 70% Robusta • 30% Arabica with Natural Pandan Leaf Essence
products.brewingRecommendation: Drip hot via Phin filter over cold condensed milk and ice for an aromatic green-fragranced Saigon Pandan Iced Coffee.

products.name: Đồng Tháp Pink Lotus Flower Scented Coffee Powder
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Ướp Hoa Sen Tinh Khiết Đồng Tháp
products.tagline: Imperial Da Lat Arabica layered over fresh Dong Thap pink lotus stamens
products.description: Drawing upon Vietnam’s centuries-old imperial royal tea scenting traditions. High-altitude Da Lat Arabica beans are layered over freshly unfurled pink lotus blossom stamens from the lakes of Đồng Tháp for 72 hours. Delivers a calming, ethereal honeyed floral tea-like clarity layered over subtle caramel.
products.beanBlend: 100% Single-Origin Da Lat Arabica Scented with Lotus Blossoms
products.originRegion: Đồng Tháp Lakes & Cầu Đất, Đà Lạt
products.brewingRecommendation: Best brewed gently via Pour Over (V60) or light Phin drip to preserve the delicate volatile floral lotus notes.

products.name: Saigon Heritage Phin Coffee Powder
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Bột Phin Truyền Thống Sài Gòn
products.tagline: The timeless blend roasted with traditional caramelized butter & dark cacao
products.description: Our signature house grind tailored precisely for Vietnamese gravity Phin filters. A master blend of 70% volcanic Buon Ma Thuot Robusta and 30% Da Lat Arabica, slow-roasted with pure French butter and raw cacao for that quintessential Saigon street cafe aroma.
products.originRegion: Buôn Ma Thuột & Cầu Đất, Lâm Đồng
products.brewingRecommendation: Best brewed with a traditional Vietnamese Phin dripper (15g coffee / 40 drops per min) over condensed milk and crushed ice.

products.name: Buôn Ma Thuột Culi Peaberry Powder
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Culi Robusta Đất Đỏ Bazan
products.tagline: Single-origin rare round pea-beans with double the caffeine & heavy body
products.description: Harvested from ancient volcanic red basalt soil (Đất Đỏ Bazan) in Dak Lak. Culi peaberries occur when only a single round seed matures inside the cherry, concentrating bold sugars, smoky cedar, dark Belgian cacao, and intense energy.
products.brewingRecommendation: Ideal for Phin brewing, Moka Pots, or rich morning espresso.

products.name: Đà Lạt Lang Biang Arabica Powder
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Bột Arabica Typica Cầu Đất
products.tagline: Highland cloud forest Arabica with fragrant wild jasmine & citrus honey
products.description: Cultivated in the misty alpine valleys of Mount Lang Biang and Cầu Đất at 1,650 meters. Organically nurtured by indigenous K’Ho families with natural washed fermentation, yielding delicate notes of bergamot, orange blossom, and crisp Fuji apple.
products.originRegion: Cầu Đất & Núi Lang Biang, Đà Lạt (1,650m)
products.brewingRecommendation: Perfect for Pour Over (V60), Aeropress, French Press, and delicate Phin black coffee.

products.name: Saigon 3-in-1 Condensed Milk Instant Coffee
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Hòa Tan 3in1 Sữa Đặc Sài Gòn
products.tagline: Authentic Cà Phê Sữa Đá in 10 seconds with micro-ground Robusta crystals
products.description: Experience the world-famous Saigon iced milk coffee anywhere. We freeze-dry real Vietnamese condensed milk with micro-ground single-origin Buon Ma Thuot Robusta crystals. Dissolves instantly in both hot and ice-cold water without clumps.
products.beanBlend: Freeze-Dried Fine Robusta + Real Condensed Milk Powder
products.brewingRecommendation: Pour 1 sachet into 75ml hot water, stir until dissolved, then add 5-6 ice cubes for instant Saigon Iced Coffee.

products.name: Pure Freeze-Dried Black Robusta (100g Glass Jar)
products.vietnameseName: Cà Phê Hòa Tan Sấy Lạnh Nguyên Chất 100g
products.tagline: 100% Pure Fine Robusta micro-crystals with zero added sugar or fillers
products.description: Produced using state-of-the-art -40°C cryogenic freeze-drying technology that locks in 99% of freshly brewed volatile coffee oils and aromatic terpenes. Delivers intense crema, bold dark chocolate notes, and pure energy with zero prep time.
products.brewingRecommendation: Use 1.5 - 2 tsp per cup. Instantly soluble in hot water, cold milk, or oat milk.

products.name: Buôn Ma Thuột Single-Origin Whole Beans (250g)
products.vietnameseName: Hạt Cà Phê Robusta Nguyên Chất Buôn Ma Thuột
products.tagline: Zero-defect specialty roasted whole beans for fresh home grinding
products.description: Direct-trade from the volcanic red earth estates of Đắk Lắk. Specially slow-roasted to a glossy dark profile that yields massive crema, chocolate fragrance, and zero sourness when ground fresh.
products.brewingRecommendation: Grind coarse for Phin/French press, or fine for 9-bar espresso machines.

products.name: Đà Lạt Typica Whole Roasted Beans (250g)
products.vietnameseName: Hạt Cà Phê Arabica Cầu Đất Nguyên Chất
products.tagline: Specialty grade single-origin highland whole beans with floral aroma
products.description: Shade-grown Arabica from Mount Lang Biang. Roasted to a refined medium roast to highlight bright citrus notes, honey sweetness, and wild jasmine aromatics.
products.brewingRecommendation: Grind medium for V60 pour over, Chemex, or French press.

products.name: Complete Vietnamese Home Barista Starter Kit
products.vietnameseName: Bộ Quà Tặng Khởi Đầu Pha Cà Phê Phin Hoàn Chỉnh
products.tagline: Everything needed to brew authentic Cà Phê Sữa Đá at home
products.description: The ultimate gift bundle: Includes 1x Solid 304 Stainless Steel Phin Dripper (6oz), 1x 250g Saigon Heritage Phin Coffee Powder, 1x Canister of Artisanal Slow-Cooked Sweetened Condensed Milk (380g), and a step-by-step 45-drop barista brewing card.

products.name: Artisan Solid Brass Vietnamese Phin Dripper (6 oz)
products.vietnameseName: Phin Cà Phê Đồng Thau Thủ Công 6oz
products.tagline: Hand-lathed heavy brass with precision gravity press for optimal thermal bloom
products.description: Heavy-gauge solid brass Phin filter with screw-down gravity plate. Retains heat 30% better than standard aluminum filters, ensuring full extraction of deep chocolate oils.

products.name: Matte Obsidian Black Stainless Steel Phin (8 oz)
products.vietnameseName: Phin Inox Đen Mờ Cao Cấp 8oz
products.tagline: Food-grade 304 stainless steel coated in sleek matte obsidian PVD finish
products.description: Modernized Vietnamese Phin filter featuring laser-cut micro-perforations for zero sediment in the cup and heat-resistant silicone rim for safe handling.
